probe_logic_review.buffer_type_reasoning: Each requested type is applied and inspected immediately in the same main-thread transaction before accessibility-node creation. The sequences cover NORMAL, NORMAL-to-SPANNABLE, NORMAL-to-SPANNABLE-to-EDITABLE, return to NORMAL, repeated NORMAL and repeated SPANNABLE.
probe_logic_review.granularity_reasoning: Uses public View.performAccessibilityAction with advertised NEXT/PREVIOUS LINE actions and requires selection 0 to 2 to 0. It is not TalkBack-service or binder-node routing evidence.
probe_logic_review.draw_reasoning: OnDraw plus one-second settle and hardware/software captures are useful, but ink is only a coarse visibility oracle and cannot identify the exact glyph by itself.

negative_control_adjudication.equal_return: Do not predeclare an exact failure count. A valid contrast requires at least one same-content buffer transition where diagnostic actual has the wrong immediate type while framework reference passes. If equal_return passes all 13 stages on an API, the early-return difference is not demonstrated there.
negative_control_adjudication.no_super_measure: No failure is presumed. A layout/granularity failure with framework reference passing supports the need for super.onMeasure. A 13/13 pass means this configuration did not distinguish it and cannot be cited as proof of necessity.

host_build3.toolchain_limit: The common 9.4.1/D8 9.4.24 toolchain is traceable for A/B/C source comparison. It is not the PR production AGP toolchain; production acceptance requires original CI APK evidence.
host_build3.rejected_build2: OUT_OF_SCOPE_INPUT_RETAINED; not used by this qualification

legacy_label_limit.fact: Generated diagnostic stages retain legacy JSON key and on-screen text containing production for oracle compatibility even though the left view is a namespaced diagnostic copy.
legacy_label_limit.required_wording: Every publication or image mapping must say legacy production label means namespaced diagnostic variant and must retain notProductionApk=true.

hardcoded_statement_limit: nativeOrTrimeApplicationStartedByProbe=false is a code literal, not observed process evidence. Any no-start claim requires external phase-bounded process and log records.
required_runtime_qualification: Bind exact installed APK SHA, embedded binding SHA, selected variant, PID/start identity, instrumentation return status and raw report for every run.
Require exactly 13 unique stages and bind every referenced hardware/software PNG by hash; preserve all failures and exceptions.
Visually inspect constructor empty, hanzi 你, latin ni, null empty and rebind 你 hardware frames plus their software captures; combine with exact text, framework Layout and accessibility-node text.
Use immediate mutation JSON for BufferType claims; screenshots cannot prove NORMAL/SPANNABLE/EDITABLE.
Use advertised actions, movement granularity and exact selection 0-to-2-to-0 for public granularity claims; screenshots cannot prove action dispatch.

Run the exact original CI-built 92b137 production APK separately. The namespaced safe copy cannot qualify production bytecode integration, native candidates, whole-app behavior, TalkBack, binder routing or physical-device behavior.
